parent_objective: design controller-family-compatible decisive task-source mapping after standard-layer plumbing pass
blocked_by: standard profile layer is not decisive for history necessity
M1615 clean package may be L3-specific and must not be used as a direct benchmark without mapping

public_gates: M1676 must design task-source mapping without running training or replay
M1676 must decide whether M1615 is diagnostic-only or safely mappable
M1676 must preserve L1 current-response, L2 current-tiled, and L3 reset controls
M1676 must specify source-diversity and control-substitution stop rules
M1676 must keep private holdout promotion actor-input changes paper-level claims and level3 claims blocked
forbidden_shortcuts: do not repair the M1663 artifact
do not use M1615 as direct benchmark without mapping

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs controller-family-compatible decisive task-source mapping after standard-layer plumbing pass
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no training, replay, PPO, promotion, private holdout, paper-level or level3 claim
stop_condition: stop if design treats M1615 as a private holdout
stop if L1/current-tiled/reset controls are omitted
stop if source-diversity and control-substitution gates are not specified
stop if implementation or pilot execution is admitted directly
fallback_plan: route to source-generation preflight if M1615 is diagnostic-only
route to package-mapping audit if M1615 has reusable task metadata
route to standard-layer negative story only if decisive task mapping is impossible under current sim
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1675 audits the standard-layer one-seed pilot and routes to decisive task-source mapping

admission_evidence: M1674 plumbing passed across all 12 profiles
M1675 identified standard-layer task limitation and M1615 mapping caveat
allowed_updates: M1676 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest if design admits source preflight or mapping audit
next_stage_criteria: source-diversity and control-substitution gates are explicit

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: high; design must create tasks where current-response and current-tiled controls are explicit challengers.
history_necessity_tests: design must require L2 normal versus current-tiled comparisons
design must require L3 online versus reset-control comparisons
design must require wrong/delayed history only after controller-family-compatible task sources exist
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1675 audit and prior public source packages only.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If current-sim cannot create decisive task sources, record a scenario-sampling limitation rather than weakening self-ID standards.
allowed_claims: task-source mapping design and route decision
no training, no replay, no PPO, no private-holdout, no paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: A controller-family-compatible decisive task-source mapping route can be designed from existing public task infrastructure without leaking L3-specific proof artifacts.
success_criteria: design states whether M1615 is diagnostic-only or safely mappable
design specifies T4/T5 source families and source-diversity gates
design chooses a concrete next source preflight mapping audit or stop route
training replay PPO promotion private holdout actor-input changes and level3 claims remain blocked
failure_criteria: design treats M1615 as direct benchmark without mapping
design omits current-response current-tiled or reset controls
design routes directly to private holdout promotion or paper evidence
decision_rule: M1676 passes if it designs a controller-family-compatible decisive task-source mapping route and chooses the next step before execution.
